title: Natural homology square for termwise finite-free pullback
statement: Let T be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], X and Z objects of D(O_T) [def-pc-derived-category], f:X→Z, and a an integer. Choose derived categories of all schemes in one morphism universe. Let W be an open in T, A and B bounded-above cochain complexes of module sheaves on W [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], each with finite free terms [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Let α:A→B and fix isomorphisms eA:L(W.ι)*X≅Q(A) and eB:L(W.ι)*Z≅Q(B) [def-pc-derived-pullback] satisfying L(W.ι)*(f) followed by eB.hom = eA.hom followed by Q(α). For any scheme morphism g:T′→T, put V=g inverse-image W, h=g.resLE W V (le_refl V), and F=Modules.tensorPullback h followed by the inverse of Modules.overEquiv V [def-pc-module-pullback]. Then F is additive. Put P=F(A), Q=F(B), β=F(α), with F applied termwise. There are isomorphisms eP:H^a(Lg*X)|_V≅H^a(P) and eQ:H^a(Lg*Z)|_V≅H^a(Q) with H^a(Lg*f)|_V followed by eQ.hom = eP.hom followed by H^a(β). No zero-term, zero-differential, component-invertibility or point hypotheses are imposed.

proof.text: Set V=g inverse-image W and h=g.resLE W V (le_refl V). Define F explicitly as tensorPullback h followed by (Modules.overEquiv V).inverse. The tensor-pullback adjunction makes it right exact and hence additive; the equivalence is additive, so F is additive. Finite free terms are finite sums of the structure sheaf, hence flat. The bounded-above flat complexes A and B are K-flat. Use one left-derived counit ε for tensorPullback h; its components at A and B are invertible. If flatComplexDerivedPullback presents another counit, the unique isomorphism of left-derived functors transports its invertibility to ε. Naturality at α gives the termwise square.

Let R_W and R_V be exact restriction to the open subschemes. The unique comparison between the left derived functor of tensorPullback W.ι and R_W.mapDerivedCategory identifies L(W.ι)* with exact restriction. The natural open-restriction comparison identifies Lg* followed by R_V.mapDerivedCategory with R_W.mapDerivedCategory followed by Lh*. Apply this comparison at X and Z, and map the given commutative square through Lh*. Compose with ε at A and B and the natural quotient/homotopy comparisons. This gives a derived commutative square with endpoints represented by tensorPullback h applied termwise to A and B. Equivalently use derived composition along the cartesian open square; the two constructions are natural for f.

Apply degree-a derived homology to that square and use homologyFunctorFactors to replace homology of Q of each complex by complex homology. Exactness of the equivalence (Modules.overEquiv V).inverse identifies homology of its termwise images with its image of homology; its unit isomorphism identifies the image of R_V of a sheaf with that sheaf restricted to the localized site over V. Compose these natural isomorphisms to form eP and eQ. Naturality at α and f proves the displayed equation. The construction uses no bottom-degree conditions. Empty V gives the same equivalences, zero ranks give zero objects, and the degree-a functor exists for every integer a.

theorem bottomFreeChain_pullback_comparison
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (X Z : schemeDerivedCategory T) (f : X ⟶ Z) (a : ℤ)
    (W : T.Opens)
    (A B : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hAbounded : ∃ c : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, c < i → IsZero (A.X i))
    (hBbounded : ∃ c : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, c < i → IsZero (B.X i))
    (hAfree : ∀ i : ℤ, ∃ n : ℕ, Nonempty (A.X i ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace) (ULift.{u} (Fin n))))
    (hBfree : ∀ i : ℤ, ∃ n : ℕ, Nonempty (B.X i ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace) (ULift.{u} (Fin n))))
    (α : A ⟶ B)
    (eA : (derivedPullback W.ι).obj X ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj A)
    (eB : (derivedPullback W.ι).obj Z ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj B)
    (hsquare : (derivedPullback W.ι).map f ≫ eB.hom =
      eA.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map α)
    (T' : Scheme.{u}) (g : T' ⟶ T) :
    let V := g ⁻¹ᵁ W
    let F := Modules.tensorPullback (g.resLE W V (le_refl V)) ⋙
      (Modules.overEquiv V).inverse
    ∃ hF : F.Additive,
      letI := hF
      let P := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj A
      let Q := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj B
      let β := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map α
      ∃ (eP : ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T'.toRingedSpace)) a).obj
          ((derivedPullback g).obj X)).over V ≅ P.homology a)
        (eQ : ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T'.toRingedSpace)) a).obj
          ((derivedPullback g).obj Z)).over V ≅ Q.homology a),
        (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T'.toRingedSpace)) a).map
            ((derivedPullback g).map f)).over V) ≫ eQ.hom =
              eP.hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap β a
